edits.why: Lines 19-20 are the last two rows of the same two-column parallel block as lines 1-18 (both columns still set side by side, 'цын! Імтінін ...' | 'hын! Імтінін ...'); the rulings make the block one MainZone-Other band, so band 3 joins band 2.

notes.text: Line 21 is a colophon ('Записано на р. Острокаменной отъ чукчанки Кутjэўт.'), indented, labelled MainZone-P by the rule. No ruling covers colophons; editor may prefer Other.
